quests.name: Supplying the Sepulcher
quests.text: Bring Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.

quests.name: Michael Garrett
quests.text: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.

quests.name: Ride to the Undercity
quests.text: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.

quests.name: Return to Podrig
quests.text: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Prove Your Worth
quests.text: Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher wants you to kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.

quests.name: Arugal's Folly
quests.text: Retrieve the Remedy of Arugal for Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Wild Hearts
quests.text: Gather 6 discolored worg hearts and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Return to Quinn
quests.text: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Escorting Erland
quests.text: Escort Erland through the wolves, to Rane Yorick.

quests.name: The Deathstalkers' Report
quests.text: Bring the Deathstalker Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Wild Eyes
quests.text: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Return to Quinn (Again)
quests.text: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.

quests.name: A Recipe For Death
quests.text: Collect 6 Grizzled Bear Hearts and 6 samples of Skittering Blood and deliver them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

quests.name: Ivar the Foul
quests.text: Kill Ivar the Foul, and bring Ivar's Head to Rane Yorick at the Ivar Patch.

quests.name: Lost Deathstalkers
quests.text: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.

quests.name: Speak with Renferrel
quests.text: Speak with Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Arugal's Folly
quests.text: Bring 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: The Dead Fields
quests.text: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields.  When Nightlash appears, kill her.  Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Border Crossings
quests.text: Retrieve the contents of one of the Dalaran wizards' crates. You will find Pyrewood Village to the south.

quests.name: Maps and Runes
quests.text: Bring the strange pendant to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Dalar's Analysis
quests.text: Take the rune-inscribed pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Dalaran's Intentions
quests.text: Speak with Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Arugal's Folly
quests.text: Bring 6 Pyrewood Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Arugal's Folly
quests.text: Kill Grimson the Pale and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: A Recipe For Death
quests.text: Retrieve Apothecary Berard's journal from Pyrewood Village and take it to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Pyrewood Ambush
quests.text: Help Deathstalker Faerleia kill the Pyrewood Council.

quests.name: Arugal's Folly
quests.text: Bring 6 Worgen Bits to Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.

quests.name: The Decrepit Ferry
quests.text: Go to the Decrepit Ferry.  Search for the reason the Scourge are there.

quests.name: Rot Hide Clues
quests.text: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: The Engraved Ring
quests.text: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

quests.name: Raleigh and the Undercity
quests.text: Bring Deliah's Ring to Raleigh.

quests.name: Thule Ravenclaw
quests.text: Bring Bethor's Scroll to Apothecary Renferrel at the Silverpine Sepulcher.

quests.name: Report to Hadrec
quests.text: Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Ambermill Investigations
quests.text: Obtain 8 Dalaran Pendants for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Rot Hide Ichor
quests.text: Bring 8 bottles of rot hide ichor to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Rot Hide Origins
quests.text: Bring the Sample Ichor to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

quests.name: Resting in Pieces
quests.text: Bring Alaric's Head to his grave.

quests.name: A Recipe For Death
quests.text: Bring 6 samples of Lake Creeper Moss, 6 samples of Lake Skulker Moss and a Hardened Tumor to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

quests.name: The Hidden Niche
quests.text: Take Alaric to the hidden alcove.

quests.name: Wand to Bethor
quests.text: Take the Woven Wand to Bethor Iceshard in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

quests.name: Stop the Spread
quests.text: Slay 5 Sickly Refugees and 5 Haggard Refugees for Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.

quests.name: A Husband's Revenge
quests.text: Kill Valdred Moray.  Bring his hands to Raleigh Andrean in the Undercity.

quests.name: Watching the Roads
quests.text: Slay 8 Dalaran Wizards and 8 Dalaran Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills
quests.text: Deliver Apothecary Renferrel's findings to Apothecary Lydon in the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

quests.name: Beren's Peril
quests.text: Locate Beren's Peril, then kill 6 Ravenclaw Drudgers and 6 Ravenclaw Guardians, then return to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: The Weaver
quests.text: Kill the Dalaran archmage, then retrieve his staff for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: A Curious Pair
quests.text: Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious Earthen Ring travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.

quests.name: A Grim Fate
quests.text: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.

quests.name: Into Fenris Keep
quests.text: Investigate Fenris Keep to the north and attempt to locate the missing member of the Earthen Ring party.

quests.name: Lumina Windsinger
quests.text: Retrieve the Fenris Isle Key from the Rot Hide Gnolls and use it to free Lumina Windsinger.

quests.name: The Windshaper's Wrath
quests.text: Accompany Lumina Windsinger and help her escape Fenris Keep.

quests.name: The Horn of Xelthos
quests.text: Find The Horn of Xelthos inside of Shadowfang Keep. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.

quests.name: The Horn of Xelthos
quests.text: Log

quests.text: Bring the Shard of Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.text: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in Silverpine Forest.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.text: Bring a Water Sapta to Tiev Mordune in Silverpine Forest if you failed to speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.text: Bring the Shard of Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.

quests.name: The Tortured Soul
quests.text: Collect a Tortured Soul from the nearby undead in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.

quests.name: The Offering Stone
quests.text: Find the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.

quests.name: The Offering of Blood
quests.text: Use the Tortured Soul to give an offering of blood at the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril.

quests.name: Assault on Fenris Isle
quests.text: Bring Thule's Head to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: The Debt
quests.text: Speak with Lumina Windsinger in the Sepulcher.

quests.name: A Moon-Kissed Blade
quests.text: Speak with Trevan Rol in the Sepulcher and bring him the materials he requires.

quests.name: An Underrated Talent
quests.text: Speak with Ott and ask him to forge your blade.

quests.name: Old Fire-Eye
quests.text: Use the Moonsilver Blade to destroy Old-Fire Eye in Silverpine Forest.

quests.name: The Eye of Bhossca
quests.text: Find The Eye of Bhossca inside of the Scarlet Monastery. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.
